Downtown Mill Avenue.name: Downtown Mill Avenue
Downtown Mill Avenue.description: Mill Avenue entertainment spine with adaptive-reuse lofts, patio-retail turnover, and the metro's densest evening shift traffic.

Hayden Ferry Lakeside.name: Hayden Ferry Lakeside
Hayden Ferry Lakeside.description: Tempe Town Lake south-shore office/residential district with class-A build-outs and the city's highest permit valuations.

ASU Campus & University Drive.name: ASU Campus & University Drive
ASU Campus & University Drive.description: Campus-edge student-housing belt with continual renovation permitting, annual tenant turnover, and university-anchored retail.

Escalante Historic District.name: Escalante Historic District
Escalante Historic District.description: Historic bungalow district with steady renovation, garage-conversion filings, and infill near the Mesa border.

Papago Park & North Tempe.name: Papago Park & North Tempe
Papago Park & North Tempe.description: North-edge recreation and research belt with hotel/office repositioning and riverfront-adjacent multifamily filings.

Diablo Stadium Corridor.name: Diablo Stadium Corridor
Diablo Stadium Corridor.description: West Tempe stadium district with seasonal hospitality churn and spring-training-driven short-term demand.

Alameda Park & Hudson Manor.name: Alameda Park & Hudson Manor
Alameda Park & Hudson Manor.description: Mid-century central neighborhoods with starter-home turnover, SES-panel permits, and rental-to-own conversions.

Apache Boulevard Light Rail.name: Apache Boulevard Light Rail
Apache Boulevard Light Rail.description: Light-rail spine with transit-oriented multifamily, international-food retail, and corridor infill permitting.

Mills Avenue & Emerald Park.name: Mills Avenue & Emerald Park
Mills Avenue & Emerald Park.description: Mills/Emerald character area with duplex conversions and small-plex new builds feeding steady rental supply.

Kiwanis Park.name: Kiwanis Park
Kiwanis Park.description: Park-anchored east Tempe with townhome infill and roof/HVAC replacement cadence on 1970s-80s stock.

The Lakes.name: The Lakes
The Lakes.description: Lakeside community near Baseline with stable owner-occupancy and water-adjacent amenity premiums.

Corona del Sol.name: Corona del Sol
Corona del Sol.description: School-district-driven family market with pool permits and kitchen/bath remodel velocity.

South Tempe Rural Corridor.name: South Tempe Rural Corridor
South Tempe Rural Corridor.description: South-edge pockets along the Chandler boundary with no-hoA infill lots and low-rise commercial pads.
